info.title: LMS AI Gateway
info.description: Chat/embedding provider routing and fallback, a versioned prompt registry, per-org quotas and cost, PII redaction, moderation and tool allow-listing, and an audit log — the only service that talks to an LLM provider on the platform's behalf.

post.description: Renders `prompt_key`'s active (or pinned) version, redacts PII, checks moderation and the org's quota, then calls the routed provider (with fallback). Set `stream: true` for an `application/x-ndjson` response instead: one `{"type": "delta", "text": ...}` line per token, then one final `{"type": "usage", ...}` or `{"type": "error", ...}` line.
